title: The zero-step computation segment
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, let $F$ be a set of states, and let $P$ be a property of work-tape head positions. If $P$ holds at the work-tape head positions of a configuration $a$, then the zero-step run from $a$ to itself avoids $F$ at all times strictly before its endpoint and satisfies $P$ through its endpoint.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ holds at the work-tape head positions of $a$
